svg.title: Subagent Hub — renderer illustration
svg.desc: Production terminal renderer at default capacity: 16 running, 32 queued, nesting depth 2. Synthetic data; not a terminal screenshot.
svg.text: ILLUSTRATION · Subagent Hub · offline synthetic demo
16 running tasks; 32 queued across two root batches.
Each lead delegates 3 checks in the foreground.
Read-only tools; no child messaging grants required.
Per task: 30 minutes, 100 requests, 100 tool calls.
No live provider requests or load-test results.
↑↓ agents · j/k line · Ctrl+u/d or PgUp/Dn page · Home/End
